IPL 2027: Rajasthan Royals Retained and Released Players List – Full Squad Ahead of Auction
 IPL 2027: Check the full list of players retained and released by Rajasthan Royals (RR) ahead of the IPL 2027 auction.
 Updated : Nov 17, 2026 21:11 IST , CHENNAI - 1 MIN READ

 Rajasthan Royals announced its list of released and retained players ahead of the IPL 2027 auction.
 Shimron Hetmyer was one of the biggest releases among the total of nine players.
 RR will go into the auction with a total purse of Rs. 27.05 crores.
 Royals now have six slots to fill, including three overseas spots.
RR released and retained players list
 Retained players: Aman Rao, M Siddharth (T), Shubham Dubey, Brijesh Sharma, Mohammed Shami (T), Sushant Mishra, Dasun Shanaka, Nandre Burger, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Dhruv Jurel, Ravi Bishnoi, Yash Raj Punja, Donovan Ferreira, Ravindra Jadeja, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Jofra Archer, Riyan Parag, Lhuan Dre Pretorius, and Sandeep Sharma.
 Released players: Shimron Hetmyer, Emanjot Chahal, Tushar Deshpande, Adam Milne, Kuldeep Sen, Yudhvir Singh, Vignesh Puthur, Ravi Singh, Kwena Maphaka, Sam Curran (T)
